# Palette bank catalog (generated by palette_gallery.py — do not edit by hand)

Columns: name · kind · n · bg · measured min CVD ΔE2000 (deutan/protan/tritan) · safe_n (how many leading colors stay ≥10 ΔE under all CVD types) · mood · source.
Use `sp.palettes.info(name)` for full metadata; images in `assets/palette_gallery_*.png`.
